name: agent-guards
description: Hooks that stop an agent from reading key files and .env files, sending text or commits that hold a key, running force pushes and other destructive git commands, and deleting whole folder trees, in Claude Code and Codex

interface.longDescription: Four hooks run before each shell command and file read the agent makes. The secret read hook refuses reads of .env files, private keys, credential files, the private data of macOS apps, and Claude Code's conversation records, and refuses a read whose file it cannot tell. The outbound hook refuses gh sends and git commits whose text, body file, or staged change holds a key-shaped value, naming the kind of key and the line without showing the value. The git hook refuses force pushes, reset --hard, --no-verify, clean -f, and commands that throw away uncommitted changes. The delete hook refuses deletes of the root, the home folder, the current folder, and system folders. Every refusal says why, and a refused git or delete command is shown with a leading ! for you to run yourself. Each hook turns off with its own environment variable, and two list files add your own secret places and protected paths. It needs Python 3.
